en_US.title: Public Ledger Leak Route

en_US.field_note: Public does not mean safe. It means harder to erase.
en_US.terminal: PUBLIC LEDGER ROUTE: packet witness hash accepted by external notary. Payload incomplete. Claimant challenge probable. Deep Reach retaliation window begins after relay acknowledgement.
en_US.audio: The truth leaves first. You may not like who reads it.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Public Ledger Leak is a partial truth ending. The player can publish enough evidence to make erasure harder without resolving Atlas or protecting the ocean-machine ecology. It is powerful, messy and not a clean victory.
en_US.external_site: The Public Ledger Leak route sends partial truth into an external record: harder to erase, delayed by custody, and dangerous before the whole machine is understood.
